'''Blitzkrieg Cup duel edition''' is a [[1on1]] tournament that is taking place on wednesday to thursday, 5—6 June [[2024]]. It will be played on a freshly designed map by {{player|kwon|flag=de}} called '''[[faust_b26]]'''. Join us on [https://discord.com/invite/m8rvTuqc Blitzkrieg Discord].
== Format ==
* Date: June 5-6
* Single-Elimination Bracket
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}
* Other maps are not allowed
